_comment: Canonical source of truth for Sibyl on-chain deployments. Update this file when (re)deploying or committing a new replay; README and tooling reference it.

SibylVault._comment: Optional ERC-4626 strategy vault (test/local only). Leave address null until a vault is deployed; the API /vault endpoints fall back to an artifact/snapshot-derived shape when absent.

latestConsensus.note: Sample live ConsensusReached emitted on-chain from Bybit-sourced signals (defining feature: decisions recorded on Mantle).

erc8004.note: Each Sibyl agent minted an ERC-8004 identity NFT (agentURI links the NFT to its SibylLedger agentId). Full records in deployments/agent-identities.json.
